description:
FOUND s473t5e (#1501 round 6, `re/` CHECK 1 + CHECK 2).  t/re/reg_nc_tie.t
reads DIFF 14/18 with FIVE aborted top-level forms:

    undef-fn:|Tie::Hash::NamedCapture|::pl-STORE
    aborted-forms:5: The function |Tie::Hash::NamedCapture|::pl-FETCH is undefined

perl implements `%+` and `%-` as tied hashes whose class is
`Tie::Hash::NamedCapture`, and the file tests that interface directly --
`tied(%+)`, `Tie::Hash::NamedCapture->TIEHASH`, `FETCH`, `STORE`, `EXISTS`,
`FIRSTKEY`/`NEXTKEY`, and the `all => 1` variant that is `%-`.  PCL implements
the two hashes NATIVELY (set_capture_groups populates them), so the VALUES are
right and the TIE is not there at all.

ROWS: 33 blessed fail rows + 5 rows short.

LAYER (CLAUDE.md 9a): a `lib/Tie/Hash/NamedCapture.pm` shim.  Everything the
class does is expressible in plain Perl over the native `%+`/`%-` -- TIEHASH
records the `all` flag, FETCH/EXISTS/FIRSTKEY/NEXTKEY read `%+` or `%-`, STORE
and DELETE are perl's own fatals ("Modification of a read-only value") -- so
NOTHING belongs in `Pl/` or `cl/` for it.  What may be needed in the runtime is
that `tied(%+)` answer an object of that class; measure whether the file's rows
need `tied` at all before touching the runtime, since the shim alone may carry
them.

CHECK WHEN DOING IT: `keys %+` order (perl's is the tie's FIRSTKEY/NEXTKEY
walk), and that a plain `$+{name}` read does NOT start going through the shim
-- that would put a Perl-level method call on the hot capture path for no gain.
subject: `Tie::Hash::NamedCapture` is absent, so `%+`/`%-` cannot be reached through the tie interface -- t/re/reg_nc_tie.t aborts five forms and loses 33 + 5 rows
